correctness.rationale: Every finite admissible word extends by zeros. Its first-last marker span gives exactly (n-s)*p(s) words. The Euler product and first-difference identity follow algebraically from this count and from the primitive comb orbit census. Cyclic nondecreasing positive gaps force equality. Every strict gap increase creates a one-time cylinder; configurations without an increase but with support endpoints likewise fail recurrence, leaving only full periodic combs and the zero fixed point. Poincare recurrence on a countable cylinder basis implies all invariant measures are convex combinations of uniform orbit measures. The exact constant sqrt(3)/(2*pi^2) follows by a dominated Riemann sum of the Hardy--Ramanujan p(n) asymptotic. The packaged independent finite enumeration script passed word/ring and asymptotic consistency checks; it is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The successive-return-time monotonicity condition is a simple structural dynamical restriction. It yields stretched-exponential orbit-segment complexity at a sharp nonzero entropy scale despite an invariant-measure simplex consisting entirely of periodic atomic measures. The exact identity between first differences of word complexity and the dynamical zeta function is a nontrivial cross-diagnostic relation for this natural shift, and the theorem provides a complete description (not an arbitrary small finite table). The partition numbers themselves and generic zero entropy are classical ingredients, not the asserted contribution.
